I_ACCESS.description: Users report errors or failures when creating accounts, signing in, or accessing the service after updates or while traveling.

I_BILLING.description: Users object to subscription requirements and restrictions on features such as skipping, replaying, selecting, downloading, and stream recognition.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing music, search failures, removed content, and dissatisfaction with recommendation features.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report unavailable downloads or offline mode, deleted and repeatedly restored downloads, and problems with SD card storage.

I_OTHER.description: Users express broad dissatisfaction, including disappointment after updates and reports that the app no longer works on their devices.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report songs stopping or failing to play, slow loading, unwanted audio behavior, and reduced video podcast playback support.

I_SUPPORT.description: Users report difficulty contacting customer support and receiving timely responses.

I_USABILITY.description: Users report intrusive or repeated advertisements and the removal of convenient playback and navigation controls.
